pins.title: Weekend Getaways from Washington DC: Virginia's Northern Neck
pins.description: A straight look at weekend getaways from Washington DC: Virginia's Northern Neck versus the Eastern Shore, drive time and traffic included. Two hours forty five minutes from DC, no Bay Bridge required.
pins.altText: Screened porch overlooking a tidal creek at Captain's Cottage on Virginia's Northern Neck, with the title 'Weekend Getaways from Washington DC: Virginia's Northern Neck.'

pins.title: Weekend Trips from DC Without Bay Bridge Traffic
pins.description: Skip the Friday Bay Bridge backup. Weekend trips from DC to Virginia's Northern Neck run about two hours forty five minutes with no toll bridge and no bottleneck, just a straight shot to the water.
pins.altText: Sunset over a tidal creek on Virginia's Northern Neck, oak branches silhouetted against the sky.
pins.keywordVariant: Weekend Trips from DC Without Bay Bridge Traffic

pins.title: Where to Go Instead of the Eastern Shore: A DC Weekend
pins.description: Thinking St. Michaels or the Eastern Shore for your next DC weekend? Here's the case for Virginia's Northern Neck instead: the same Chesapeake water, none of the Friday bridge traffic.
pins.altText: Split image: a screened porch over the water above, an oak-framed creek sunset below, on Virginia's Northern Neck.
